title: DeCoRL: Decomposed Consistency Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Image Composition
abstract: arXiv:2610.39265v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multi-image composition (MICo) is a critical yet challenging capability for large-scale image editing models, where consistency degrades rapidly as the number of reference images increases. While supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can equip models with basic MICo ability, it provides only implicit supervision on the composed image and often fails to learn reliable object-level correspondence across multiple references. We propose DeCoRL, a reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that improves MICo consistency by decomposing holistic MICo consistency into object-level consistency. DeCoRL first establishes instruction-relevant object correspondences across reference images and localizes the corresponding regions in the generated image. translated_title: DeCoRL：面向多图像合成的分解一致性强化学习
translated_abstract: 多图像合成（MICo）是大规模图像编辑模型的一项关键但极具挑战性的能力，随着参考图像数量的增加，一致性会迅速下降。尽管监督微调（SFT）可以使模型具备基本的MICo能力，但它仅对合成后的图像提供隐式监督，往往无法学习到跨多个参考图像的可靠对象级对应关系。我们提出了DeCoRL，这是一种强化学习（RL）框架，通过将整体的MICo一致性分解为对象级一致性来提升MICo的一致性。DeCoRL首先在参考图像之间建立与指令相关的对象对应关系，并在生成的图像中定位相应区域；然后利用一个在单对象一致性标注上训练的基于VLM的奖励模型，产生细粒度的对象级反馈，这些反馈被聚合为多对象一致性奖励，以指导强化学习后训练。
tldr: DeCoRL提出了一种强化学习框架，通过将多图像合成的整体一致性分解为对象级一致性，并借助基于VLM的奖励模型提供细粒度的对象级反馈，从而有效提升多图像合成的一致性。
en_tdlr: DeCoRL is a reinforcement learning framework that improves multi-image composition consistency by decomposing holistic consistency into object-level consistency and leveraging a VLM-based reward model for fine-grained, object-wise feedback.
